$comment: Canonical list of Janaka's independent products and reference projects. Consumed by scripts/gen-jsonld.py (Person.owns on the hub, ItemList on /products/, SoftwareSourceCode on case-study pages), scripts/gen-public-data.py (api/public/v1/projects*.json, llms.txt) and the WebMCP tools. The visible cards live in partials/side-projects.html and products/index.html; scripts/validate-site.py fails when a project here is missing from those pages or a product link there is missing here. Facts and wording: .claude/skills/brand-voice/SKILL.md.

projects.name: AssetCare
projects.summary: A production-deployed Java 25, Spring Boot, Angular and Kubernetes application demonstrating modern full-stack, cloud-native and AI-assisted software engineering.
projects.availability: Open source reference application, not for sale.
notes: Runs on one Hetzner CX33 created by Terraform; CI, security and release pipelines on GitHub Actions with signed multi-arch images.
The observability stack (Prometheus, Grafana, Loki, Tempo, OpenTelemetry) is an optional profile and is not running in production.

projects.name: nüchtern
projects.summary: Fasting companion that keeps the biology visible: phase timer, hydration, electrolytes. Offline, German and English.
projects.privacy: Records stay on the user's device.

projects.name: Daily Momentum
projects.summary: A quiet record of where the day went: one tap says what you are doing, everything else is derived. On-device only.
projects.privacy: Records stay on the user's device.

projects.name: Loop
projects.summary: Remembers what repeats and learns the rhythm from your own history, on your device or your own Drive.
projects.privacy: Records stay on the user's device or in storage the user owns.

projects.name: BabyLoop
projects.summary: Two-tap care log for babies and toddlers, with a daily summary and a PDF for the paediatrician. On your device or your own Drive.

projects.name: LeftHere
projects.summary: Take a photo and it remembers where you left the car, keys, bag or a favourite place; the map walks you back. On your device or your own Drive.
